The main takeaway from our work is that
, while state of the art CNNs achieve impressive detection accuracy and latency on COTS embedded platforms, the best in class network is not the best performing one on a given platform.

, while there is no one-size-fits-all solution to object detection, the choice of the best network architecture is not the only factor affecting performance, and a significant amount of effort is required to properly configure the network and the platform for achieving the best trade off between accuracy and performance.

, despite the recent improvements, state of the art object detection networks are still not ready for deployment on embedded platforms for real-time inference, and that further research efforts are needed to achieve the required performances.
